_comment: The build that is ACTUALLY LIVE at https://arnjnnngs.github.io/chemowell-app-beta/.
This file exists because release_check.sh needs a baseline it can trust, and in this
environment `origin/main` is not one: pushes are manual GitHub web uploads and the sandbox
has no network, so origin/main is never fetched afterwards and silently points one release
behind reality. A CACHE bumped in the PREVIOUS release then reads as 'bumped' against that
stale base, and the gate prints a green tick on a build that never bumped it -- the app-v40
silent-stale-cache failure again, wearing a checkmark. (Found by the app-v53 PM gate,
logged in BACKLOG.md as blocking the next release, fixed in app-v55.)
A committed record cannot go stale the way a remote ref can, because updating it is part of
the push itself. Update it by running ./mark_published.sh IMMEDIATELY AFTER a successful
push, and commit the result. Never edit it by hand to make the gate pass -- release_check.sh
cross-checks these values against the recorded commit and will refuse a record that lies.
